bootErrorResetHint: If this keeps happening, you can erase the app's local data and start afresh.
bootErrorResetBody: This permanently deletes everything stored in this browser — documents, notes, citations and backups. It cannot be undone.
cloudKeyErrorTitle: These notes were locked on another device
cloudKeyErrorBody: Enter the passphrase you created there to unlock them. This device is signed in but can't read them yet.
cloudKeyErrorResetBody: This erases the notes stored in this browser and starts fresh. Notes saved on your other devices are kept.
